status: non-normative design catalog; not executable schema or production wire
stop_wire_note: Owner Stop remains outside immutable m1b-broker/1 union; candidate application records cannot be inserted into it.

OperationDescriptor.owner: versioned semantic catalog; kernel validates admission meaning

fields.errors: closed per-version typed application error catalog
fields.loss_report: exact unsupported or degraded semantics; unknown distinct

invariants: No operation version changes meaning in place
UI aliases bind complete argument transformation and version
Presentation-local operations cannot mutate canonical authority/work facts
Native and upstream execution retain exact capability differences without hidden helper inference

fields.command_id: canonical ID unique within admitted authority domain; any principal-local client ID is injectively/durably mapped before canonical admission
fields.semantic_digest: digest of immutable typed intent semantics including principal/grant binding; excludes only declared non-authoritative client/audit/transport identities
fields.principal_grant_ref: authenticated principal and current attenuated authority reference; never raw credential
fields.expected_revisions: separate authority, pause, configuration, route, process and object revisions
fields.causation_correlation: durable source IDs and parent operation lineage
fields.delivery_policy: e.g. explicit steer or queue, never interchangeable
fields.deadline: explicit policy time input bound to original operation
fields.reservation_ref: existing admitted bounded parent resource lineage when required

invariants: Current grants and fences rechecked at effect admission
Same ID plus same intent returns old receipt without duplicate effect
Same ID plus changed semantic bytes conflicts
Receipt-retention uncertainty requires reconciliation, not new-ID retry
One canonical retry owner per operation
No surface-specific defaults can affect authority/effects
Principal/grant binding is immutable command content, not an implicit extra canonical key component
Different domain never resolves a receipt by command ID alone
Historical receipt disclosure cannot redispatch after effect revocation

deduplication_mapping_proposal.same_key_same_digest: authorized historical receipt lookup; never a new dispatch grant
deduplication_mapping_proposal.client_namespace_alternative: explicit injective durable mapping of client/principal-local ID into canonical ID before kernel/receipt lookup
deduplication_mapping_proposal.reader_boundary: current authenticated reader/domain/scope authorization before lookup/disclosure
deduplication_mapping_proposal.frozen_m1a: unchanged; this is proposed production ingress/lookup composition

fields.receipt_refs: canonical receipt references or explicit unavailable

invariants: Transport timeout is not proof of no effect
Application codes do not extend M1B closed reason alphabet
Unknown stays distinct from false/zero

ReceiptFacts.owner: canonical command/effect records; local save fact explicitly client-local

fields.saved_locally: local durable intent fact; not acceptance
fields.accepted_or_refused: canonical sequence, writer epoch and precondition evidence
fields.dispatch: attempt identity, route and original authority epoch
fields.delivered_applied: per-recipient generation and exact observed meaning
fields.effect_settlement: settled|unresolved with evidence; independent of process exit

invariants: Facts may coexist; not one optimistic scalar badge
ACK is not effective application or external settlement
Missing final counters remain null/unknown
Original and fork reservation lineages are not duplicated

QueryRequest.owner: authorized read interface over reconstructable projections

fields.source_cut: pinned canonical cut or latest returning actual cut

invariants: No inference, implicit indexing, probing or disabled activation
Equal source cut, audience, filters and versions give equal canonical results
Unknown/absent/incomplete are distinct
Private canonical sequence density not automatically exposed

ProjectionSnapshotManifest.owner: reconstructable projection service; fact provenance checked against canonical/store evidence

fields.source_identity: writer epoch/canonical source cut/source stream IDs
fields.projection_identity: version, schema digest, build identity and filter revision
fields.replay_window: real floor and snapshot cursor with cursor unit
fields.materialization: snapshot payload digest and available locator
fields.coverage: complete|partial|unknown, gap marker and reconstruction facts
fields.positions: received, installed and acknowledged independently tracked

invariants: Candidate application record outside immutable M1B messages
Wire consistency does not authenticate retention loss or snapshot existence
Snapshot verified and installed before cursor advance
Canonical append precedes presentation coalescing
No cross-audience snapshot or continuation reuse

InteractionRecord.owner: canonical interaction state, projected by Attention views

fields.request_action_digest: immutable request or consequential action meaning
fields.created_expiry: canonical creation and explicit validity limits

invariants: One current answer per waiter; duplicate is idempotent
Old generation or changed action cannot consume replacement waiter
UI presence and notification click never confer approval
Locally drafted response is not delivered/adopted

fields.namespaces: view and command IDs excluding reserved core collisions
fields.grants: functional, filesystem, egress, credential refs, model, accounting and update dimensions independently declared

invariants: Disabled executable activity zero; bounded metadata overhead reported
Opening/focusing/splitting view never implicitly activates
Origin/signature/marketplace is provenance, not a grant
No view receives unconstrained mutable kernel or credential-bearing environment

ConfigTransaction.owner: shared deterministic resolver/compiler plus kernel admission

fields.principal_authority: current principal/grants and acknowledged widening if applicable
fields.provenance: per-field sources, merge operators, constraints and reasons
fields.rollback: inverse candidate diff; irreversible portions explicit

invariants: Stale base rejects atomically, no last-write-wins
Preview pure; apply revalidates
Restrictive authority fence immediate regardless of preference application
Rollback new admitted revision; never decrements fences or rolls back external effects
Undefined privacy/publication partial orders block qualification

IntegrationBinding.owner: replaceable adapter/client with independent runtime lifetime owner

fields.commands: allowed typed mappings with no second admission

invariants: Optional integration not mandatory for adapter-free recovery
View detach cannot close runtime-owned harness connection
No raw provider credentials exposed to frontend
OSC/editor/MCP output never treated as instruction authority

PerformanceProfile.owner: preregistered experiment profile; not product SLA

fields.bounds: finite resource/queue/control/tail budgets; unset means blocked measurement claim
fields.metrics: p50/p95/p99 input/frame/append/control/recovery; throughput; CPU/RSS/wakeups/IPC/disk/handles; coalescing and mandatory retention
fields.hard_zeros: model/index/disabled activation due to passive view operations
fields.analysis: independent run units, inclusion/censorship, quantile/CI methods and full vector

invariants: No hidden scalar score
No source-documented mechanism becomes local performance result
N0 frame is not-applicable; missing metric unknown
Hard floors precede latency/efficiency rankings

Privacy exposure and publication authority partial orders
Empirical budget values and supported profiles
